name: Cua Huynh De
summary: Cua Huỳnh Đế is the deep-water crab. Vietnam Airlines describes a red-pink thick shell, white meat, and rich roe, and prints a wide price. ZaloPay places it at Sa Huỳnh and Lý Sơn and adds a hotpot.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the meat white, firm, deeply sweet, and mildly fragrant, and the roe very rich. ZaloPay calls the meat firm, fragrant, and richly sweet.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: steam, grill with salt and chili, or cook as porridge.
ZaloPay: steam, porridge, or hotpot. It places the crab in clean water at Sa Huỳnh and Lý Sơn.
No hour was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Airlines says deep sea and names no beach. ZaloPay names Sa Huỳnh and Lý Sơn.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 900,000–1,800,000 VND a kilogram, depending on type and size. ZaloPay printed no price.
